description: Run a Solana transaction against mainnet's current state without sending it, before anyone signs: whether it would succeed, every instruction by name (decoded with each program's IDL), compute used and the limit to set, and what it would change in each writable account: SOL before and after, accounts created or closed, an owner change, and every decoded field that changes (a pool's reserves, a position's liquidity, a token account's balance), decoded with the owner's IDL like account_decode. A transaction that would fail is explained like tx_explain, with fixes. Pass the serialized transaction, base64 (as wallets and SDKs produce it) or base58, signed or unsigned; an old blockhash is fine. Use for 'will this work?', 'what will this transaction do?', 'what does this unsigned transaction change?'. Read-only: nothing is sent.

transaction.description: The serialized transaction, base64 or base58

name: simulate
title: Dry-run a Solana transaction
